# ASE Technologies - Complete Website Information

## Organization

Name: ASE Technologies
Website: https://asetechnologies.in
Primary email: info@asetechnologies.in
Phone: +91 87126 55512
Service locations: Visakhapatnam, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Vijayawada
Primary campus location: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India

ASE Technologies provides digital marketing and software for growing businesses. Its two main service areas are marketing services and custom software/SaaS applications.

## Digital Marketing Services

### Search Engine Optimization

ASE Technologies provides:

- Technical SEO
- Local search optimization
- Search intent research
- Content optimization
- Website architecture improvements
- Organic visibility measurement

SEO is offered alongside Answer Engine Optimization and Generative Engine Optimization, helping brands remain discoverable in traditional search and AI-assisted answers.

### Social Media Marketing

Social media services include channel planning, content creation, posting, paid campaigns and community management across relevant channels, including Facebook and Instagram.

### Paid Advertising

Paid advertising support includes:

- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- Search and display campaigns
- Campaign planning
- Conversion tracking
- Performance reporting

### Content Marketing

Content marketing includes editorial planning, useful long-form writing, search-focused content and distribution. It is designed to build authority and answer customer questions.

## SaaS and Custom Software

### Eswari Connects

Eswari Connects is a real-estate CRM for property and sales teams.

Key capabilities:

- Lead capture
- Team assignments
- Project inventory
- Buyer enquiry management
- Follow-up tracking
- Site visit coordination
- Sales workflow from capture to closure

### SmartEduConnect

SmartEduConnect is an education ERP for schools and education teams.

Key capabilities:

- Admissions
- Attendance
- Fees
- Exams
- Staff operations
- Parent communication
- Family updates

### Additional Software

ASE Technologies also develops:

- AI-Powered WhatsApp automation
- Hospital management systems
- Clinic management systems
- Real-estate CRMs
- Ecommerce applications
- Restaurant applications
- School management systems
- Custom web applications
- Custom mobile applications

## Website Design and Development

Services include responsive website design, accessible layouts, clear customer journeys, performance-focused development and business software development.

## Graphic Design

Services include:

- Brand identity
- Visual identity systems
- Marketing creative
- Campaign assets
- Social media graphics
- Packaging and other business design assets

## Academy

ASE Digital Academy offers in-person, instructor-led digital marketing training in Visakhapatnam.

Training areas include:

- SEO
- Social media
- Advertising
- Content marketing
- Practical project work
